note: A transition entry is not executable enforcement. Codex implements these predicates, atomicity and source-specific edge cases. Additional legal transitions require a recorded contract amendment.

rules.required_predicate: Authenticated owner accepts exact objective/scope and the kernel records the finite grant.
rules.on_failure: Identity/policy/scope unknown -> remain CREATED or BLOCKED; no work dispatched.

rules.required_predicate: A material unresolved interpretation prevents identifying the permitted task.
rules.on_failure: Ask a bounded question; preserve raw request and prior work.

rules.required_predicate: Every typed hard prerequisite, current policy and required evidence predicate is satisfied.
rules.on_failure: Keep BLOCKED/PENDING with actual unmet conditions.

rules.required_predicate: Atomic claim commits with real executor identity, current input/graph, lease/fence, capacity and non-overlapping scope.
rules.on_failure: Conflict cannot yield a second active claimant.

rules.required_predicate: Actual receipt, output artifacts, required observations and exact candidate/input binding verify.
rules.on_failure: Malformed/stale result fails or remains INDETERMINATE; do not release successors.

rules.required_predicate: Typed bounded operation, actual inputs, required staged artifacts, reviews and current consent are established.
rules.on_failure: Reject unknown target, unsupported predicate, missing consent or stale review.

rules.required_predicate: Authority/read-set still current; reservation and durable intent are committed atomically under the kernel.
rules.on_failure: No external effect on missing authority or incomplete storage commit.

rules.required_predicate: Broker checks authenticated peer, current fence, permit, revocation, actual resource handle and preconditions, then consumes once.
rules.on_failure: Reject replay or revocation winning the admission race.

rules.required_predicate: Bounded broker dispatches the exact registered operation with admitted parameters.
rules.on_failure: Uncertain post-dispatch failure becomes INDETERMINATE; no automatic refund/replay.

rules.required_predicate: Actual owned process termination is observed and exit/output retained.
rules.on_failure: Stream loss or client timeout alone is not process termination.

rules.required_predicate: Independent required observation establishes the specified postcondition and the kernel settles against current state.
rules.on_failure: Exit zero without result evidence stays unverified or becomes failed/indeterminate.

rules.required_predicate: Crash/acknowledgment loss leaves a possible external effect without sufficient settlement evidence.
rules.on_failure: Preserve spent/uncertain permit and fence resource-dependent new work.

rules.required_predicate: Fresh observations plus the adapter predicate establish the defensible settlement; new authority admits any compensation.
rules.on_failure: Acknowledgment alone or matching current bytes without causal evidence cannot invent historical attribution.

rules.required_predicate: Authenticated stop disables new admission at the declared boundary and sends bounded owned-worker stop/termination.
rules.on_failure: Retain partial results and actual uncertainty; do not report STOPPED yet.

rules.required_predicate: Owned workers are observed stopped and no further admission is possible; unresolved effects remain separately recorded.
rules.on_failure: Timeout or unknown backend keeps a stopping/recovery status.

rules.required_predicate: Object-scoped proof, current policy/epoch, real required quorum and approved consumer boundary validate.
rules.on_failure: Keep sealed on missing authority/domain/time/integrity; never downgrade to ordinary decryption.

rules.required_predicate: Permitted operation completes, actual key/buffer cleanup is performed to the qualified profile and outcome evidence is committed.
rules.on_failure: Cleanup uncertainty seals/degrades the dependent lane and retains the failed proof obligation.

rules.required_predicate: Declared tests/thresholds, real configuration, reviewer independence and evidence match this capability profile.
rules.on_failure: No promotion from liveness, mocks, inherited history or package checks.

rules.required_predicate: Authorized correction/lifecycle transition preserves original provenance and updates effective retrieval/dependent claims.
rules.on_failure: Never overwrite original history to simulate having always known the correction.

rules.required_predicate: Exact rehearsal, backup/restoration, quiescence and current owner cutover approval all exist.
rules.on_failure: Keep old profile authoritative and new target isolated until all activation conditions hold.
